space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

at.description: When the statement stopped holding, RFC 3339, after its validFrom and not after now; default: now

reason.description: wrong: it never held; outdated: it stopped holding; duplicate: another record says it

note.description: Why, at most 500 characters. Secrets are masked

expectVersion.description: Refuse with MEMORY_CONFLICT unless this is the record's current version
